independent_review.disagreement: Frozen lane label calls this an added night. The coordinator's less-redacted target projection indicates the guest requested a later arrival than the described booked arrival and said an extra night was already added; this suggests removing that night. The independent reviewer rechecked its stricter projection and agreed the extension direction was unverified. HMS and the attachment are not verified; the original frozen label is preserved.
